item.body:
### Summary

As a user, I want to clear the app's caches from the settings, so that I control the storage the app uses.

### Scope

Cache clearing in Réglages > Maintenance. This is what is left in M5 of LOT-179 (#419): on 2026-11-09 the operator moved the cache **sizes** to M4 (#655), because the legacy reference `2fe43da3` shows them; clearing has no reachable counterpart there, so it stays an evolution.

- Module: App · Difficulty: easy · Priority: low · **M5** (UX evolution; M5 is opened by the orchestrator)
- The (b) half of the LOT-120 split, after LOT-179 kept only the sizes (`docs/LOTS.md`, M5 section). GAP ids: 152. UXD: none.
- Legacy at `2fe43da3`: a "Vider le cache ?" alert exists (`HFRswift/Swift/AppSettingsView.swift:637-644`, `clearCaches` `:272-286`: resets the tabs, removes `ImageCache` and `SmileCache`) but nothing presents it (`showClearCacheConfirmation`, `:118`, is never set to true); the ObjC `PlusSettingsViewController` "EmptyCacheButton" is not routed in the SwiftUI app. Spec: `docs/lots/LOT-187-cache-clearing.md`.

### Depends on

- LOT-179 (#419)

### On hold

Held by the M5_OPEN decision: M5 opens after the M4 parity is validated, and the orchestrator opens it (operator decisions of 2026-11-02 on #379). ([decision](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/379#issuecomment-6573879240))

### Model

Sonnet → Opus (AGENTS.md §6: the reviewer is never the author model)

### Captures needed

- none known (no HFR request)

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An optional evolution: the legacy UX stays the default, the change is a separate entry (UX principles of `docs/FEATURES.md`).
- [ ] The spec has its "Legacy counterpart" and "UX evolutions" sections ([TEMPLATE](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/blob/dev-swift/docs/lots/TEMPLATE.md)).
- [ ] View logic lives in `@Observable @MainActor` models tested with Swift Testing in `App/SwiftHFRTests/`; each new test is shown to fail without the change.
- [ ] `xcodebuild build test` green on the iPhone 18 Pro and an iPad simulator (iOS 27.0), and the `App build + tests` CI job green.
- [ ] UI strings in French; light, dark and Dynamic Type XL checked; no new dependency.

### Before you start (agents and humans)

Read, in order: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/agents/ORCHESTRATION.md, docs/agents/REVIEW-ROUNDS.md, docs/agents/LESSONS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, App/README.md, ADR 0012, the spec of every dependency (docs/lots/).
